design_status.allowed_claim: supplemental benchmark comparison on the locked formal 168-candidate universe
forbidden_claims: clear SOTA based on an unregistered or post-hoc endpoint
design_status.manuscript_note: The current manuscript states that no revised 168-candidate method comparison is reported. If this benchmark is later reported, the manuscript and Supplementary baseline registry must be updated to describe this exact Case-2-specific method suite and DeepSeek V4 Pro backend.

data.candidate_construction: 7 frozen pathway PRS x 8 imaging markers x 3 longitudinal outcomes
data.external_validation_reason: Case Study 2 is supplementary; independent external validation is reserved for Case Study 1.

candidate_input_contract.invalid_output_rule: Every invalid, duplicate, missing, or unmappable proposal consumes its requested slot and receives no anchor credit; no manual repair is permitted.

methods.suite_reason: Continuity with the sealed historical Case Study 2 seven-method comparison; this is a Case-2-specific suite and is not silently substituted for the manuscript's generic six-family baseline table.
methods.completion_rule: Take at most 80 valid ordered anchors, ignore uncalibrated self-reported confidence, place valid unique anchors first in extracted order, place one zero-relevance sentinel for every invalid/duplicate/missing slot through slot 80, then append the same deterministic compiler order for every not-yet-ranked candidate. Every real candidate appears exactly once; the auditable experiment stream therefore has 168 plus the number of failed generation slots, and ties are broken lexically by candidate_id.
methods.native_retrieval_reason: Freeze supplied evidence and prevent time-varying live retrieval or accidental access to local result artifacts. Baselines are transparent frozen-input workflow adaptations, not claims of full native internet-enabled reproduction.

neurodiscovery.kg_snapshot: current canonical full_v2 snapshot pinned by bytes and SHA256; not a temporal hindcasting freeze
neurodiscovery.policy_rule: Use the canonical deterministic Case 2 mapper directly. Do not transfer the historical 210-candidate policy weights, because those weights were selected using development outcomes that overlap the present formal outcome set.

model_backend.route_switch_rule: Switch route only after confirmed quota exhaustion.
model_backend.secrets_policy: Read channel keys only from keys_file at runtime; never place secret values in prompts, logs, checkpoints, manifests, environment snapshots, or command-line arguments.

trials.pairing: matched trial index across all seven methods
trials.seed_derivation: little-endian uint32 from the first four SHA256 digest bytes of 'case2_adni_formal_benchmark_v1:trial:<index>'

primary_metric.name: bootstrap_weakest_link_evidence_ndcg
primary_metric.definition: Full-ranking NDCG with candidate relevance min(50, -log10(max(a_path_hc3_p, b_path_hc3_p, indirect_bootstrap_p))).
primary_metric.reason: The formal global binary endpoint has zero positives, so a prespecified continuous ranking endpoint is required for an identifiable primary comparison.

multiplicity_labels.primary_global_q_lt_0_05: formal biological primary label but non-identifiable as a generator-ranking metric because there are zero positives

comparison.test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip test on the primary metric
comparison.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap interval for the paired mean difference
comparison.multiplicity: Holm correction across the six NeuroDiscovery-versus-baseline comparisons

evaluation.reporting_rule: Report all seven methods and all ten trials, including invalid slots and negative or null results. This post-result-design-freeze benchmark cannot by itself support a prospective or preregistered superiority claim.
